task: Upgrade the Vibeclubs homepage hero into a runtime-proof first viewport and harden reduced-motion reveal visibility.
surface: Vibeclubs homepage hero, mobile proof strip, and shared motion primitives.
audience: Vibe coders, AI-native builders, small maker crews, OSS contributors, and Arcanea/FrankX ecosystem builders who expect an immediately legible format, not another meeting product.
first_read: A visitor should understand that Vibeclubs is a format powered by an extension overlay: the crew stays where it already works, while Vibeclubs adds soundtrack, timer, and recap.

keep: Canonical hero line and builder voice.
Existing lightweight Framer and CSS atmosphere.
avoid: Decorative orb as primary focal asset.
Reduced-motion paths that hide the page until animation hydration.
direction.signature: A compact extension runtime proof: tab, crew, faders, timer, and recap outcome.
system: Desktop: replace hero card with a structured extension overlay proof panel.
Mobile: add three-part proof strip before CTA.
Motion: preserve entrance wrappers for no-preference users and force final visible state for reduced motion.
Copy: use Vibeclubs voice and keep proof labels short.
QA: capture desktop, mobile, and mobile reduced-motion screenshots.

asset_quality.why_premium: The primary hero asset shows the actual Vibeclubs operating mechanism instead of decorative atmosphere: extension overlay, faders, timer, crew context, and recap outcome.

artifacts.notes: Adds VibeRuntimeProof, MobileRuntimeProof, icon-led CTAs, and removes SparkOrb from the hero focal area.

checks.name: playwright-e2e
checks.evidence: corepack pnpm test:e2e was attempted after install. Browser tests could not launch because Playwright expected missing local chromium_headless_shell-1217; the request test also hit a reused/stale port 3000 server before the port was cleaned. No repo source failure was confirmed by this run.

checks.name: typecheck
checks.evidence: corepack pnpm --filter @vibeclubs/web typecheck reports two broader release blockers: Supabase table access collapses to never across app routes, and React/@types skew makes shared UI/Radix components invalid JSX. Targeted compatibility probes for schema records and row type aliases did not resolve the failures, so this needs a dedicated Supabase/React type modernization pass rather than a runtime-proof hero patch.

checks.name: pnpm-install
checks.evidence: corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --force passed with pnpm 9.0.0 after the earlier global pnpm 11 ignored-builds guard was identified as the wrong package-manager path for this repo.

score.notes: Visual ship standard met locally, but release remains gated: proof object, mobile hierarchy, voice, package install, changed-file lint, and visual QA pass. Deductions: local production build/typecheck are blocked by repo-wide TypeScript residuals, and live host/deploy path is not yet attached to the Starlight Vercel project.

release_blocker_assessment.verdict: Do not promote this branch until TypeScript and deploy ownership are resolved.
safe_to_keep: Voice audit, changed-file ESLint, whitespace, and visual QA evidence.
release_blocker_assessment.latest_investigation: Schema record and row type alias probes were reverted after they did not change the typecheck failure shape.

known_risks: vibeclubs.ai is live but was not found as a project in the known Starlight Vercel team; production deploy path needs owner/provider confirmation.
DNS points to 216.150.x.x addresses rather than the usual Vercel edge record.
Full app typecheck currently fails on Supabase table inference collapsing to never plus React/Radix JSX compatibility errors.
Repo Playwright E2E needs the expected local chromium_headless_shell-1217 browser revision before it can serve as a release gate.
Use corepack pnpm for repo gates; global pnpm 11 is not the right install path for this pnpm@9 repo.
Local visual QA used Next dev because production build is gated by the repo-wide residuals above.
